note: Cartoon launch video. Beats play in order. voice: narrator (female), aarav (male, Hinglish), or none (text only). Myna (the assistant, built on the Bolo models) speaks only in text bubbles: it has no voice yet. Numbers in {BRACES} are filled from results/ before the narration is generated; spoken numbers are written as words. Each beat has a style: the TTS description is '<speaker> speaks in <style>, with very clear audio and no background noise.' Pitch and pace vary beat to beat so the narration never sounds flat. 'say' variants: the TTS reads 'Myna' as 'Mina', so lines with the name are spoken from respelled variants and a take is kept only if whisper hears my-na.

beats.text: Meet Aarav. It is two in the morning, and his project is due tomorrow.
beats.style: a hushed, intriguing, storyteller voice, slightly low pitched and slow, like the start of a mystery

beats.caption: docker chalu karo!
beats.style: a tired, hopeful voice, slightly fast

beats.caption: volume thoda kam karo

beats.text: Like millions of people in India, Aarav speaks Hinglish. Most voice assistants do not.
beats.style: a gently amused, wry and expressive voice at a moderate pace

beats.text: This is Myna, a voice assistant built on Bolo. It is small enough to live on his laptop, and it understands Hinglish.
beats.style: a bright, excited, highly expressive voice, slightly high pitched and a bit fast, like revealing a surprise
